methodologyNotes: Covers complete, ready-to-paddle kayaks sold at a published US MSRP, spanning recreational, touring, fishing, inflatable, and folding designs. Excludes bare hulls sold without a seat, stand-up paddleboards, canoes, and accessory-only drive units. Price is typical US MSRP in USD. kayakType is one of sit-on-top, sit-inside, inflatable, or folding. propulsion is one of paddle, pedal, or motorized (factory pedal/motor drive as sold). seatingCapacity is the manufacturer-rated number of paddlers (integer). lengthInches is overall hull length in inches. widthInches is maximum beam in inches. weightPounds is bare hull/fitted weight in pounds (excludes paddle and cargo). maxCapacityPounds is the manufacturer maximum load rating in pounds. constructionMaterial is the primary hull material as one of rotomolded-polyethylene, thermoformed, polypropylene, pvc-inflatable, or hypalon. hatchCount is the number of sealed/covered storage hatches (integer). rodHolderCount is the number of built-in molded or flush-mount rod holders (integer; 0 if none). adjustableSeat is a boolean for a factory adjustable/removable framed seat. trackingAid is one of none, skeg, or rudder as equipped from the factory.
